metadata.name: Pi Agent
metadata.description: View Pi Agent sessions, capabilities and model settings for new sessions in Driver.

folder.title: Folder tasks
folder.subtitle: Pick a folder you authorize and let {agent} read and write files in it. {agent} never sees the real path and cannot run terminal commands.
folder.unavailable: This version of the app has not opened folder access or the Agent service to this plugin yet.
folder.stale: This view has expired. Go back and open it again.
folder.notAuthorizedDetail: Allow “Access folders you choose”, “Use the Agent service” and “Invoke models with your account” in this plugin's permissions so {agent} can work in a folder.

modeHint.chat: Read only: can view and search files, never changes anything.
modeHint.plan: Can only create or edit plan Markdown files (such as plan.md); everything else is read only.
modeHint.yolo: Can create and edit files in the folder. Changes are written straight to your folder.

folder.modeChanged: Mode changed. The next message starts a new conversation.
folder.runtimeMissing: The runtime component is not authorized for this plugin yet.
folder.emptyLog: Tell {agent} what to do in this folder, for example “list this folder” or “summarize the README”.
folder.placeholder: What should the Agent do? (⌘↩ to send)
folder.failed: This did not finish. Please try again later.
folder.openSetupFailed: Could not open the settings page. Open it from the extension details instead.
folder.rootLost: Access to the folder “{name}” is no longer valid. Choose it again.
folder.pickRejected: This folder cannot be authorized (a system or app folder). Choose another one.
folder.folderUnavailable: The folder is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
folder.resultExpired: This task's result has expired; the task will not run again.
folder.queryFailed: Couldn't check the task's progress; it may still be running. You can check again or stop it.
folder.restoreFailed: Couldn't read the previous progress. Reopen this page later to try again.
folder.saveFailed: Couldn't save this request's progress, so it was not sent (otherwise it could not be stopped after closing). Please try again later.
folder.inputTooLong: This instruction is too long (over 64 KB). Shorten it and send again.
folder.stopNotSaved: Couldn't save the stop request. If you close this page before the task ends, press Stop again after reopening.
folder.stopUnconfirmed: The stop couldn't be confirmed. Press “Retry stop” before closing this page.
folder.pendingUnknown: The last request was interrupted before it was confirmed, so it's unknown whether it started. Check again (resubmits the original request; it may run again if the Host never received it or the plugin was disabled/re-authorized meanwhile), or press Stop to discard it (deletes this session, cancelling any running task).
